pending_commit.commit_message: chromeos-config: Support build config diff testing This adds support so builds can maintain a master build config dump file in their respective chromeos-config-bsp repos. At build time, if they copy this master file into /build/[name]/tmp/chromeos-config, this file will get picked up by chromeos-config and checked against the generated dump (from the current yaml/dt config) to verify that no unexpected changes occurred. This will be used to both verify coral/fizz during migrations and also to verify no unexpected changes occur when editing the core libraries themselves. BUG=b:78274444 TEST=FEATURES=test emerge-coral chromeos-config with pass/fail cases Change-Id: I057ea5c6027a4953359812c8e398f8974e3ae165 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1312644 Commit-Ready: C Shapiro <shapiroc@chromium.org> Tested-by: C Shapiro <shapiroc@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Gregory Meinke <gmeinke@chromium.org>
